entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her palace, now."
entries.dialogueText: Her palace, now.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Grey clouds hung low on the horizon..."
entries.dialogueText: Grey clouds hung low on the horizon. A strong wind was picking up, and waves crashed violently on the rocky cliffs below me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Grey clouds hung low on the horizon..."
entries.dialogueText: Grey clouds hung low on the horizon. A strong wind was picking up, and waves crashed violently on the rocky cliffs below me.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A half-brother. I suppose congratu..."
entries.dialogueText: "A half-brother. I suppose congratulations are in order."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She ran a hand along the terrace's..."
entries.dialogueText: She ran a hand along the terrace's gold-plated railing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The future king of Rizia. At least..."
entries.dialogueText: The future king of Rizia. At least as the law would have it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I'd met Vina here to tell her priva..."
entries.dialogueText: I'd met Vina here to tell her privately before informing the world. As I looked at her stony expression, I wondered if I had made a mistake.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why, thank you. I accept.""
entries.dialogueText: "Why, thank you. I accept."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that this is a lot to take..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that this is a lot to take in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please. At least try to be happy f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please. At least try to be happy for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll always be my favorite, Vina.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll always be my favorite, Vina."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes. It is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. It is."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's all you have to say?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's all you have to say?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I am trying.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am trying."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""In what way?""
entries.dialogueText: "In what way?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've based my entire life on the i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've based my entire life on the idea that I was the future queen of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I spent so many hours attending co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I spent so many hours attending council meetings..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I went to so many balls and etique..."
entries.dialogueText: "I went to so many balls and etiquette classes..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I gave up the chance to be with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave up the chance to be with the man I loved..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I let you talk me into marrying my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I let you talk me into marrying my own cousin, because you said that was what was expected of the heir to House Toras!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All while you went about consolida..."
entries.dialogueText: "All while you went about consolidating your power, even getting rid of the House of Delegates to keep yourself and your... son in charge."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I went to Pales as the heiress to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I went to Pales as the heiress to the Rizian throne, and we all know what happened there..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All while you went about making li..."
entries.dialogueText: "All while you went about making life miserable for the commoners. To the point of mass unrest."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All while you went about making re..."
entries.dialogueText: "All while you went about making reforms that I suggested without even consulting me on them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She wrapped her kerchief tighter ar..."
entries.dialogueText: She wrapped her kerchief tighter around her head as a gust of wind blew.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Tell me, Father. What was it all f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, Father. What was it all for?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina. Don't you remember when we w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina. Don't you remember when we were sitting down there on the beach and I warned you that exactly this might happen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing is set in stone. In fact,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing is set in stone. In fact, I would prefer that you succeed me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I haven't forgotten what I told yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't forgotten what I told you down there on the beach long ago. Rizia's succession laws need not stay in place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen. I would love to name you m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen. I would love to name you my successor. But it's not as easy as that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What the hell, Vina? You go on and..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell, Vina? You go on and on about wanting change, and now you're begging to be named successor to a position that doesn't even hold weight anymore?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes brimmed over with fury. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes brimmed over with fury. She opened her mouth to retaliate, then shut it and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You're right. Of course you're rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Of course you're right."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Because it's all I have, Father!""
entries.dialogueText: "Because it's all I have, Father!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes brimmed over with fury. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes brimmed over with fury. She stalked away and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Circumstances have changed, haven'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Circumstances have changed, haven't they?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She froze and looked up at me cauti..."
entries.dialogueText: She froze and looked up at me cautiously.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I-- I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I know."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You already broke the rules on my..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already broke the rules on my behalf once. I won't ask you to do it twice."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She froze and looked up at me cauti..."
entries.dialogueText: She froze and looked up at me cautiously.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You mean that?""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. Lucita and I are in love and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Lucita and I are in love and having a child together. Whether that child takes the throne doesn't matter to us."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What's so complicated? You've chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's so complicated? You've changed enough laws at this point..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes. I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I know."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes brimmed over with fury. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes brimmed over with fury. She stalked away and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked a few steps away and sat..."
entries.dialogueText: She walked a few steps away and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I will say this.""
entries.dialogueText: "But I will say this."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""My darling husband doesn't give a..."
entries.dialogueText: "My darling husband doesn't give a damn whether he's Crown Prince Consort or not. But his family does."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""My darling husband married me with..."
entries.dialogueText: "My darling husband married me with the expectation that his children would inherit the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If that doesn't happen... well, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that doesn't happen... well, I don't see the Rizia-Pales reunion lasting for very long."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You favored them greatly by return..."
entries.dialogueText: "You favored them greatly by returning Zille to Brenas. Name me your heir, and you'll have their loyalty forever."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Whether or not it's symbolic is of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether or not it's symbolic is of no consequence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're underestimating the threat..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're underestimating the threat of House Azaro. If I rob my son of his birthright, it'll be both of our heads on the chopping block."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tradition is tradition. Your partn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tradition is tradition. Your partner and his family will just have to respect that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Let me just say this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me just say this."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I am the Duchess of Valenqiris. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the Duchess of Valenqiris. The only person House Toras loves more than me is Rico."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And I'm married to him.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I'm married to him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And you did away with him.""
entries.dialogueText: "And you did away with him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If I'm removed as heir to the thro..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I'm removed as heir to the throne, there'll be hell to pay from my province."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't even have any marriage p..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't even have any marriage prospects. You're as barren as a fig tree in winter."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And whose fault is that?""
entries.dialogueText: "And whose fault is that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can cajole and threaten all yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can cajole and threaten all you want. It's not going to change my mind."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know. But if you love me, at lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. But if you love me, at least think about what I'm saying."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your arguments make sense. I am we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your arguments make sense. I am weighing my options carefully."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I am the wife of Rico Toras. Our h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the wife of Rico Toras. Our house is expecting our bloodline to keep the throne. No Azaros invited."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If I'm removed as heiress, there'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I'm removed as heiress, there'll be hell to pay from Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Royal Council reshuffle is com..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Royal Council reshuffle is coming up. What if I gave you a promotion?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can't promise that they will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't promise that they will."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's not his birthright if you cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not his birthright if you change the law."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Good. It's an important decision.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. It's an important decision."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She paused, then shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She paused, then shook her head.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But... it matters to House Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "But... it matters to House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Even if the throne is only symboli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if the throne is only symbolic at this point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, but I'm still weighing my opt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but I'm still weighing my options. It's complicated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know what a good monarch you'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what a good monarch you'll be. You deserve it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave me a grateful half-smile."
entries.dialogueText: She gave me a grateful half-smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But what about House Azaro? I'm su..."
entries.dialogueText: "But what about House Azaro? I'm sure they'll be furious if their heir isn't named successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your Aunt Bea would have my nether..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Aunt Bea would have my nether parts on a guillotine if I removed Rumburgian blood from the line of succession."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""She would, wouldn't she?""
entries.dialogueText: "She would, wouldn't she?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't take your mother's blood o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't take your mother's blood out of the line of succession. I owe her that much."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I shouldn't sit on a council all m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shouldn't sit on a council all my life like Ms. Werner. I should *have* a council."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her head whipped towards the door...."
entries.dialogueText: Her head whipped towards the door. Lucita had come to fetch me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leave me to deal with the Azaros.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leave me to deal with the Azaros."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's a good point. This won't be..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a good point. This won't be an easy decision to make."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Azaros aren't the only player..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros aren't the only player on this chess board. Don't forget about your beau."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If they retaliate, I'll be the one..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they retaliate, I'll be the one they go after first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're thinking in such medieval t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're thinking in such medieval terms. All three of Rizia's noble houses should be able to live in peace together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're the one who wants to be que..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the one who wants to be queen. Are you willing to spend the rest of your life looking over your shoulder?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She set her jaw."
entries.dialogueText: She set her jaw.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes. I think so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I think so."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Ideally, yes. Some of these people..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ideally, yes. Some of these people seem to have no idea it's 1957."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, of course he and his family a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course he and his family are a factor."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Speaking of which...""
entries.dialogueText: "Speaking of which..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You're running out of time to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're running out of time to make it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her belly was straining the confine..."
entries.dialogueText: Her belly was straining the confines of her gown. Vina curtsied to her politely.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Hello, Duchess Azaro. I mean, Quee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, Duchess Azaro. I mean, Queen Consort Azaro. Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Please. 'Lucita' will do just fine.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please. 'Lucita' will do just fine."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They'll be ready for the announcem..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll be ready for the announcement in five minutes, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need five minutes. I know..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need five minutes. I know what I'm going to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Splendid. I'll be right in.""
entries.dialogueText: "Splendid. I'll be right in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leave me to think. Both of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leave me to think. Both of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife and my daughter both smiled..."
entries.dialogueText: My wife and my daughter both smiled with confidence, then looked at each other suspiciously.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita took my hand and led me insi..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita took my hand and led me inside the palace. Vina followed from a distance.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Father."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both my wife and daughter gave me m..."
entries.dialogueText: Both my wife and daughter gave me meaningful looks before turning around and heading in.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Let's go, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go, then."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The normally spacious sitting room..."
entries.dialogueText: The normally spacious sitting room of Palas Toras had been filled with lighting and camera equipment, all pointed at the purple velvet divan against the back wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Above it hung portraits of Ana Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: Above it hung portraits of Ana Azaro and Ariana Toras.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita and I were seated. An assist..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita and I were seated. An assistant quickly refreshed our makeup.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The camerawoman counted down from f..."
entries.dialogueText: The camerawoman counted down from five. It was time for my announcement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked once more at the roiling o..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked once more at the roiling ocean.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Was I ready to sever my ties with m..."
entries.dialogueText: Was I ready to sever my ties with my late wife?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Even if I hadn't loved Lena... was..."
entries.dialogueText: Even if I hadn't loved Lena... was I ready to sever all ties with her?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "What would be the cost of breaking..."
entries.dialogueText: What would be the cost of breaking tradition and naming our daughter as heiress?

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The current succession law is sexi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The current succession law is sexist and outdated. The eldest *child* should inherit the throne, not the eldest son."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Furthermore...""
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you want to continue the progre..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want to continue the progress Queen Lyza started, it's only natural to acknowledge the eldest *child*, not the eldest son, should inherit the throne."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Furthermore...""
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And would it be worse than the cost..."
entries.dialogueText: And would it be worse than the cost of keeping it?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I steeled myself and headed inside."
entries.dialogueText: I steeled myself and headed inside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My fellow Rizians.""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow Rizians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's right, another speech from..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right, another speech from your king. I hope you're not sick of me yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My dear subjects.""
entries.dialogueText: "My dear subjects."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""O children of this blessed land.""
entries.dialogueText: "O children of this blessed land."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My friends and countrypeople.""
entries.dialogueText: "My friends and countrypeople."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your King has an announcement to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your King has an announcement to make."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you have all grown to love..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you have all grown to love my wife Lucita as you have grown to love me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the wake of our triumph in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the wake of our triumph in the Pales war, we have yet another achievement to announce."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Having successfully restored stabi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having successfully restored stability in the realm, I have news that will bring you further reassurance about the monarchy's future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am pleased to tell you all that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am pleased to tell you all that the Queen Consort is about to bear me a son."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita placed a hand on my shoulder..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita placed a hand on my shoulder and smiled for the cameras.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My wife's pregnancy is no secret i..."
entries.dialogueText: "My wife's pregnancy is no secret in the realm. Now, we have discovered she is carrying a boy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As was promised by holy scripture,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As was promised by holy scripture, a new star rises. One whose renown will eclipse even mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In a matter of weeks, a new prince..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a matter of weeks, a new prince shall join the ranks of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His name shall be Prince Romus the..."
entries.dialogueText: "His name shall be Prince Romus the Second."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His name shall be Prince Taddeus t..."
entries.dialogueText: "His name shall be Prince Taddeus the Second."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His name shall be Prince Valero th..."
entries.dialogueText: "His name shall be Prince Valero the Second."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall name him Ardos, after one..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall name him Ardos, after one of the most devout Wruhecist disciples."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused for dramatic effect."
entries.dialogueText: I paused for dramatic effect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's smile grew taut."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's smile grew taut.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's smile grew wider."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's smile grew wider.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""According to the traditions of thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the traditions of this great kingdom, a monarch shall be succeeded by his or her eldest son. A woman can inherit the throne only if she has no brothers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you all know, Rizia is now a co..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you all know, Rizia is now a constitutional monarchy. The line of succession does not carry as much importance as it used to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My daughter left us before her tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter left us before her time. Since then, the question of who will be your ruler after I am gone has been unclear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With my daughter gone forever, my..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my daughter gone forever, my son has every right to claim the title of Crown Prince."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will soon have two children, a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will soon have two children, a son and a daughter. One of them will be your ruler after I am gone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Though I am overjoyed at becoming..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though I am overjoyed at becoming a father for the second time, I cannot neglect the inspiration my daughter Vina has been to this country and to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby declare an exception to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby declare an exception to the law. Princess Vina {RiziaDLCText.VinaLastName} will remain my successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby declare that from hencefo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby declare that from henceforth, Rizian succession law will favor a king's eldest child, whether male or female. It is time to let go of our patriarchal ways."
entries.menuText: "I hereby declare that from henceforth, Rizian succession law will favor a king's eldest child, whether male or female. It is time to let go of our patriarchal ways." [-5 Authority]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In accordance with Rizian law. I s..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with Rizian law. I shall be succeeded by the son of Queen Consort Lucita Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In recognition of the contribution..."
entries.dialogueText: "In recognition of the contributions made by the honorable House Azaro to this kingdom, I am proud to officially name their new heir as my successor."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's grip tightened on my shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's grip tightened on my shoulder. Her nails practically pierced through my suit jacket.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, choosing an official succ..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, choosing an official successor was not an easy decision for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "With that in mind, choosing an official successor was not an easy decision for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Choosing an official successor was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Choosing an official successor was not an easy decision for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When I thought about whom I would..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I thought about whom I would want succeeding me, the answer was clear as day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I beg of you, my public, to recogn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg of you, my public, to recognize the heir that I name today. Rizia can ill afford another War of Succession."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But rest assured that the Royal Fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "But rest assured that the Royal Family shall continue to lead Rizia through thick and thin, no matter who is at the helm."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby declare an exception to o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby declare an exception to our kingdom's laws. Princess Vina Toras will remain my successor, even in exile."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita squeezed my shoulder. Her ey..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita squeezed my shoulder. Her eyes were shining with gratitude.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When your new prince ascends the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "When your new prince ascends the throne, you shall love, honor and respect him as you have me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Having said that, with my daughter..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that, with my daughter sadly no longer eligible for the throne, my son will be the one to succeed me."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This may not be easy for some of y..."
entries.dialogueText: "This may not be easy for some of you to accept. But times are changing, and Rizia must change with them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Regardless of who succeeds me, your queen and I are so excited to start a family together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "To my loyal allies in House Azaro, I know this announcement will come as a disappointment. Please know that it was not meant as a slight against you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Long live Crown Prince {RiziaDLCTe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Long live Crown Prince {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From Ariana to Lyza, the Toras fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "From Ariana to Lyza, the Toras family has a history of strong female rulers. Now, there shall be many more to come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To my family members. Rest assured..."
entries.dialogueText: "To my family members. Rest assured that though her name has changed, Vina shall always be a Toras at heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First Valero, then myself, now my..."
entries.dialogueText: "First Valero, then myself, now my son. The line of Toras kings shall be unbroken."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rest assured this will not affect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured this will not affect our reunification with Pales. If need be, I shall marry my son to a Palesian noblewoman."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Your son and his heirs will bear t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your son and his heirs will bear the Toras name. My children won't. It makes sense for our family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, if you're watching this... t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, if you're watching this... the pressure on you is over. You can do anything you like, marry anyone you like. Forgive me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your queen and I are so excited to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your queen and I are so excited to begin this new chapter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "With a Toras and an Azaro on the throne and a Sazon married to the Princess, Rizia's three houses are united once more."

entries.dialogueText: The same kind of storm had almost killed my daughter all those years ago. I had come so close to losing her then.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now, she was on the verge of losing..."
entries.dialogueText: Now, she was on the verge of losing everything.

entries.dialogueText: The same kind of storm had almost killed my daughter all those years ago. I had come so close to losing her then.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if I had lost her now."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if I had lost her now.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now, I had lost her for real."
entries.dialogueText: Now, I had lost her for real.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The future king of Rizia. At least..."
entries.dialogueText: The future king of Rizia. At least as the law would have it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina was missing. For all anyone kn..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was missing. For all anyone knew, she was dead. My son was very likely my only possible heir.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina was dead. My son was my only p..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was dead. My son was my only possible heir.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But by naming him as such, would I..."
entries.dialogueText: But by naming him as such, would I be severing ties with my daughter for good?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But by speaking the words out loud,..."
entries.dialogueText: But by speaking the words out loud, would I be severing ties with my daughter's memory?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita came out to fetch me. Her be..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita came out to fetch me. Her belly strained the confines of her gown.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "They're expecting us inside, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I am their King. They can wait for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's go. It's cold out here anywa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go. It's cold out here anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still don't know what I'm going..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't know what I'm going to say."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A new prince means new hope for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new prince means new hope for the kingdom. This will be easy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""True. Take your time, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "True. Take your time, then."

entries.dialogueText: She took my hand and led me inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "My darling fiance doesn't give a damn whether he's Crown Prince Consort or not. But his family does."

entries.dialogueText: In her hands, she clutched the set of test results I'd just given her. She read the words once more, as if repeating them would undo their truth.

entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sex: Male.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sex: Male."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled sympathetically."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled sympathetically.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hope you're not too put out, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're not too put out, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Really, I'm so impressed with the intelligence and poise you've shown these past years..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "My son will be lucky to have you as a role model."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She embraced Vina. My daughter hugg..."
entries.dialogueText: She embraced Vina. My daughter hugged her back somewhat uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should really go find Vina.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should really go find Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A new king of Rizia. My legacy is..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new king of Rizia. My legacy is secured."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""*Our* legacy.""
entries.dialogueText: "*Our* legacy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Hello yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hello yourself."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Wait. One moment.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. One moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope Vina doesn't hate me... whe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope Vina doesn't hate me... wherever she is."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You made the right choice. For eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made the right choice. For everyone."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Forget about my house for a moment.""
entries.dialogueText: "Forget about my house for a moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I broke a promise just now. I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "I broke a promise just now. I hope your house is satisfied."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She reached beneath the folds of he..."
entries.dialogueText: She reached beneath the folds of her gown and unholstered her dagger.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I once swore I would never give al..."
entries.dialogueText: "I once swore I would never give all of myself to anyone. That I would always keep a part of my heart protected."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She handed me the weapon."
entries.dialogueText: She handed me the weapon.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You have me, King Romus. All of me.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have me, King Romus. All of me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I *hadn't* named our son-to..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if I *hadn't* named our son-to-be my successor?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's about time you stopped carryi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's about time you stopped carrying that thing around. Someone could get hurt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should keep that. The Crown st..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should keep that. The Crown still has enemies, as you well know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll have you right here on this s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have you right here on this sofa if you keep up that talk."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shh. The TV crew's still right her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shh. The TV crew's still right here."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""None that my king can't handle.""
entries.dialogueText: "None that my king can't handle."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A moot question. You never would h..."
entries.dialogueText: "A moot question. You never would have done that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It wasn't queenly behavior, anyway.""
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't queenly behavior, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're closer than ever to our goal..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're closer than ever to our goal. Building the strongest, most secure kingdom Merkopa has ever seen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A pity he'll never get to reign th..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pity he'll never get to reign the way I and my father did. But that was what I signed my family up for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Without the pressure to rule hangi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without the pressure to rule hanging over his head, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} might be able to have a normal childhood. I'm almost jealous of him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm starting to think that I am no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm starting to think that I am not the king from the prophecies. But {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} will be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The power of God runs through our..."
entries.dialogueText: "The power of God runs through our son's veins, just as it does mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope I'll be a better father thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope I'll be a better father this time around."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it was."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took my hand."
entries.dialogueText: She took my hand.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Toras-Azaro dynasty will not b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Toras-Azaro dynasty will not be stopped."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes. Almost...""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Almost..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Then I suppose we should stay on h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I suppose we should stay on his good side once he's born."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I can feel it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can feel it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank God for second chances.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God for second chances."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You could always abdicate... jokin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could always abdicate... joking, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry I didn't run his name by you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry I didn't run his name by you first. Inspiration just struck me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""{RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} is perfect.""
entries.dialogueText: "{RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} is perfect."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a faint, muffled sob coming..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a faint, muffled sob coming from the direction of the terrace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and I stood on the back terrac..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and I stood on the back terrace of my palace in Monqiz.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Need I remind you that you *promis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Need I remind you that you *promised* I would succeed you? What's going to happen if you break your word?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You know me. You know what kind of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know me. You know what kind of monarch I'll be. Can you say the same of a fetus who'll spend his life under the influence of the Azaros?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promised the Azaros that my son..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promised the Azaros that my son would be granted his birthright. If I break that promise, it'll be both our heads on the chopping block."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What?! How could you promise both..."
entries.dialogueText: "What?! How could you promise both things at the same time?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Azaros aren't a bad influence...."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros aren't a bad influence. I'm proud our houses are united."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""United for now. How long until the..."
entries.dialogueText: "United for now. How long until they take over?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You gave the Azaros Pales. Do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You gave the Azaros Pales. Do you have to give them the throne, too?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I am -- was-- the Duchess of Valen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am -- was-- the Duchess of Valenqiris. The only person House Toras loves more than me is Rico."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She glanced towards the door."
entries.dialogueText: She glanced towards the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've talked enough already. I don..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've talked enough already. I don't owe her any more explanations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt she will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt she will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'll go see her. You should r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'll go see her. You should rest."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No, but...""
entries.dialogueText: "No, but..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leaving Lucita on the divan, I push..."
entries.dialogueText: Leaving Lucita on the divan, I pushed open the door to the terrace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina was standing by the railing, h..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was standing by the railing, her back to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You never really wanted the job an..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never really wanted the job anyway, right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why did you have to run out like t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why did you have to run out like that? It was embarrassing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't have another choice. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't have another choice. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess of Valenqiris. Not a bad t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess of Valenqiris. Not a bad title."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Prime Minister's wife. Not a b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Prime Minister's wife. Not a bad title."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Grand Duchess of Pales. Not a bad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Grand Duchess of Pales. Not a bad title."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll make it up to you, Vina. I pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make it up to you, Vina. I promise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned around. A single tear st..."
entries.dialogueText: She turned around. A single tear streamed down her cheek.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm happy for you, Father. Really,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy for you, Father. Really, I am."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Get out of my palace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Get out of my palace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stayed frozen in place, sta..."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stayed frozen in place, staring at me in anger and disbelief.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I just need some time.""
entries.dialogueText: "I just need some time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked off without another word..."
entries.dialogueText: She walked off without another word.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I really must be going. Excuse me.""
entries.dialogueText: "I really must be going. Excuse me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Never mind. I'm not about to give..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. I'm not about to give you parenting advice."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was 26 now -- a full-grown woma..."
entries.dialogueText: She was 26 now -- a full-grown woman with a husband and a life of her own.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was 26 now -- a full-grown woma..."
entries.dialogueText: She was 26 now -- a full-grown woman with a life of her own.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But when I looked at her, I saw the..."
entries.dialogueText: But when I looked at her, I saw the toddler who kept wandering into my study even with an army of caretakers to keep her occupied.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The child whom I'd consoled after h..."
entries.dialogueText: The child whom I'd consoled after her mother's death, even when it meant fighting back my own grief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The child whom I'd consoled after h..."
entries.dialogueText: The child whom I'd consoled after her mother's death, hiding the fact that I felt nothing myself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The teenager who'd lost herself for..."
entries.dialogueText: The teenager who'd lost herself for hours in history books, coming down to supper with questions my mother and I couldn't answer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The daughter I'd almost lost -- twi..."
entries.dialogueText: The daughter I'd almost lost -- twice.

entries.title: Narrator: "The daughter I'd failed."
entries.dialogueText: The daughter I'd failed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The daughter I'd let down."
entries.dialogueText: The daughter I'd let down.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let the little twerp wear the crow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the little twerp wear the crown on his head. You'll always be the one with the real power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I moved to embrace her."
entries.dialogueText: I moved to embrace her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get over yourself. The Vina I know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get over yourself. The Vina I know would never put on such a pathetic display of entitlement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trust me, you dodged a bullet. Rul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me, you dodged a bullet. Ruling Rizia is the worst."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hugged me back tightly."
entries.dialogueText: She hugged me back tightly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She flinched and took a quick step..."
entries.dialogueText: She flinched and took a quick step backwards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She wiped her eyes and struggled to..."
entries.dialogueText: She wiped her eyes and struggled to smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sadness vanished from her eyes...."
entries.dialogueText: The sadness vanished from her eyes. She spoke in a flat monotone.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Looks like the worst of the bad we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like the worst of the bad weather is over. Let's get some air."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I helped her up and we stepped back..."
entries.dialogueText: I helped her up and we stepped back out onto the terrace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun had broken through the clou..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun had broken through the clouds, setting the waves ablaze in glittering light.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The horizon was limitless."
entries.dialogueText: The horizon was limitless.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our real legacy will be the monarc..."

entries.title: Narrator: "She let out a pained laugh."
entries.dialogueText: She let out a pained laugh.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Why bother? Her Majesty Queen Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why bother? Her Majesty Queen Vina will just tear that down anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll make it up to your family. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make it up to your family. I swear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's 26 years older than {RiziaD..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's 26 years older than {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}. If she doesn't end up having children, her brother might yet inherit the throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She let out a pained laugh."
entries.dialogueText: She let out a pained laugh.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes. Nobody's done more for the wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Nobody's done more for the women of Rizia than you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And the promise you made to my fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the promise you made to my family? Did that mean nothing?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She let out a pained laugh."
entries.dialogueText: She let out a pained laugh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She let out a pained laugh."
entries.dialogueText: She let out a pained laugh.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I feel so reassured.""
entries.dialogueText: "I feel so reassured."

entries.dialogueText: At just that moment, the sun broke through the clouds, setting the waves ablaze in glittering light and illuminating the smile on my daughter's face.
